description: Fetch DNS records for a domain via DNS-over-HTTPS. Supports A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, CAA, PTR. Multiple types are fetched in parallel. NXDOMAIN is returned as nxdomain: true in the result, not as an error — it means the domain does not exist in DNS.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name or hostname to query (e.g., "github.com", "mail.example.com").

types.description: Nonempty list of DNS record types to fetch; duplicates are queried once. Defaults to [A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS]. Specify more types to expand coverage (e.g., add CAA to check certificate authority authorization).

items.description: A DNS record type to fetch.

name: whois_get_dns

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_domain`: Input is not a valid FQDN. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nxdomain.description: True when the domain does not exist in DNS (NXDOMAIN / Status 3). Records will be empty. This is a valid data signal, not an error.

query_sources.description: One entry per unique requested type, in first-requested order.

items.description: Resolver attribution for one requested type.

source.description: Resolver whose successful response was consumed, including empty answers and NXDOMAIN.

type.description: Requested DNS record type, which may differ from an answer type.

records.description: DNS records returned for the requested types.

data.description: Record data (IP address, hostname, text, etc.).

source.description: Aggregate resolver indicator: cloudflare when any query consumed a successful Cloudflare response; otherwise nextdns. See query_sources for each requested type.

title: DNS Record Lookup
